thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 08/16/2018: SYMC, AVLR, CSCO, JD, AMZN

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 08/16/2018: SYMC, AVLR, CSCO, JD, AMZN
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT -0.08%
AAPL +1.65%
IBM +1.02%
CSCO +3.21%
GOOG -0.51%
Technology stocks weakened somewhat Thursday afternoon, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 fading to a nearly 0.5% gain while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has turned negative late in the session, slipping about 0.1%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Symantec ( SYMC ) gained Thursday after the company said Starboard Value hedge fund has submitted its five-member director slate. The cyber-security software company said its nominating and governance board committee is evaluating the candidates, adding the board and Symantec executives also have been meeting with other activist investor groups over the past several weeks and is planning to continue those talks.
In other sector news:
+ Avalara Inc ( AVLR ) raced almost 12% higher on Thursday after the maker of business-tax compliance software said its Avalara TrustFile software suite was available on Amazon.com's ( AMZN ) marketplace appstore and now gaining access to other companies that sell products or services on the e-commerce giant and helping them focus more of their time on business and less on sales tax filings and compliance issues.
+ Cisco Systems ( CSCO ) climbed almost 6% on Thursday, stopping only 28 cents shy of its 52-week high of $46.37 a share after the firm reported fiscal Q4 financial results above analyst estimates and forecast Q1 earnings and revenue growth also above Wall Street expectations on the success of its new Catalyst series, application growth and continued strength in security.
+ JD.com ( JD ) was nearly 1% higher Thursday afternoon, recovering from a nearly 4% drop to a 16-month low of $31.19 per American despository share after Q2 profit fell almost 50% compared with year-ago levels and missed Wall Street forecasts.
